decisions.question: How should JSON files be loaded so edits dynamically reflect on the webpage while keeping single-file/file:// compatibility?
decisions.answer: Import data/*.json in src/data/portfolio.ts for bundled/HMR reactivity and provide usePortfolioData() with runtime fetch refresh when served over HTTP(S)
